verdict.rationale: LM Studio's first-party docs say users can attach documents to chat messages and interact with them entirely offline ("RAG"), and the 0.3.0 release notes describe built-in document Q&A that works with any local model. A community comment mentions RAG plugins (ChromaDB), adding light independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of how retrieval is triggered automatically, supported file types and size limits, and hands-on independent reports of document-chat quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation

citations.quote: You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline, also known as "RAG".
LM Studio 0.3.0 comes with built-in functionality to provide a set of document to an LLM and ask questions about them.
LM Studio 0.3.0 supports this with any local model that can run in LM Studio!
